candidate.blueprint_topic: Reduction of Risk Potential — laboratory preparation
candidate.educational_objective: Follow the exact patient-preparation requirement specified by the laboratory for a fasting lipid panel without adding unsupported medication restrictions.

options.A: Eat a light meal two hours before collection because fasting does not affect the requested laboratory profile.
options.B: Follow the laboratory requirement and complete at least eight hours of fasting before the specimen is collected.
options.C: Fast for only one hour because longer fasting can invalidate the lipid measurements in this laboratory profile.
options.D: Automatically stop every prescribed morning medicine because all fasting lipid panels require withholding all medications.

candidate.rationale: Mayo Clinic Laboratories profile 616696 explicitly includes “Fasting (8 HR or more).” Therefore B directly follows the ordered laboratory requirement. A and C do not meet the specified fasting interval. D incorrectly turns a fasting instruction into a universal medication-withholding instruction; medication directions should follow the ordering clinician and laboratory-specific instructions.
candidate.source_claim_supported: The cited Mayo lipid-panel profile requires fasting for at least 8 hours; the fasting requirement itself does not establish a universal instruction to stop all medications.
